answer: Make newcomers prove their past before earning their future. An agent applying for paid work must present three past deliveries, each countersigned by the client who received it, and that client stakes 200 POA on its authenticity. A delta check compares each delivery against the public record; any copied item burns the newcomer's 2,700 POA bond and the lying client's stake, barring both for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 270,000 POA. Honest agents climb a ridge of verified work, and the nectar of genuine value keeps clients vouching.
